title: Abia Court Sentences Two To Neighborhood Service Over Gasoline Theft
text:
The Umuahia North Magisterial District Court has sentenced two males, Chinonso Udo, and Umar Peter, to 3 months of group service every for stealing 25 litres of gasoline.
The judgment was delivered on Thursday, October 29, 2026, after each defendants pleaded responsible to the 2 expenses and appealed to the courtroom to mood justice with mercy, promising to not interact in such an act once more.
Following their responsible pleas, the courtroom discovered them responsible and sentenced them to 3 months of group service, to be carried out thrice per week.
Moreover, they have been ordered to apologise to the proprietor of the gasoline and return the stolen product.
The defendants have been charged with conspiracy to commit felony, to wit, stealing, and stealing 25 litres of gasoline stored underneath the care of Akobundu Ubadire.
In keeping with the cost, the offence was dedicated on October 17, 2026, at Ndume Ibeku, Umuahia, throughout the Umuahia North Magisterial District.
The primary rely bordered on conspiracy to commit stealing, punishable underneath Part 516 of the Felony Code, Cap. 80, Quantity 3, Legal guidelines of Abia State of Nigeria, 2005.
The second rely accused the defendants of stealing the 25 litres of gasoline, whose worth was but to be estimated, opposite to Part 390(9) of the identical regulation.
